title: The iconic Arthur Read made his TV debut 30 years ago
content: The animated series "Arthur" premiered on PBS Kids on Oct. 7, 1996.

title: Dennis Hastert, longtime Republican House speaker who went to prison, dies at age 84
content: ennis Hastert, whose political legacy as Congress' longest-serving Republican House speaker was later fouled by allegations that he had molested high school athletes during his prior career as a teacher and wrestling coach, has died, a coroner said Monday. He was 84.

title: Drones buzz overhead, troops hunker underground in Ukraine's hellish kill zone
content: The front line in the Russia-Ukraine war stretches more than 700 miles and has barely moved in four years. Yet straddling this line is the kill zone, dominated by constantly evolving drone technology.

title: FBI arrests a woman accused of spying on Taiwan leader's family for China
content: The FBI and U.S. prosecutors say Wanying Zhang, also know as Heather, surveilled the Taiwanese president's son and his family.

title: Imran Khan supporters march in Pakistan to demand his release after talks failed
content: Talks between Khan's party and the government failed two days ago. Besides Khan's release, protesters demand his transfer to a hospital and family visits.

title: SCOTUS hears major climate change case. And, Brazil's presidential race goes to runoff
content: The Supreme Court is set to hear a blockbuster climate change case that could affect more than just climate issues. And, Brazil's presidential race is too close to call.

title: FlyDubai attacker intended to crash plane into Tel Aviv airport, investigation finds
content: The ongoing investigation has found the attacker intended to crash the plane into Israel's Ben Gurion International Airport, a person familiar with the matter but not authorized to speak publicly told NPR.

title: Nobel medicine prize goes to 3 scientists for research into brain activity
content: The Nobel Prize in medicine was awarded Monday to three scientists working on the mechanisms the brain uses to switch on, or off, the activity of individual nerve cells.

title: Former Prince Andrew files legal action to quash warrants that led to residence searches
content: A judicial spokesperson confirmed that Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor had filed a claim with the High Court in London and a hearing would take place Thursday.

title: Spain's prime minister calls early elections as pressure mounts over housing crisis
content: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announced early elections Monday after his government suffered a bruising legislative defeat last week on emergency measures related to the country's housing crisis.
